name: Beata Szydło - § 7/3
title: REPORT on the security of energy supply in the EU
part_text: ‘non-fossil’ and ‘in a transition period;  draws attention to the important role that the optimal use of high-efficiency cogeneration, in line with the Energy Efficiency Directive, can play in contributing to balancing the electricity grid and to the competitiveness of some industrial sectors, especially those that do not have alternative ways of producing affordable heat in their industrial processes; stresses the need to modernise and expand district heating grids to this end;’
